Search BNF codes in OpenPrescribing

Source: R/openprescribing.R
search_op_bnf.Rd

Looks up BNF chapters, sections, paragraphs, chemicals, products and presentations by name or code, to find the code to give to get_op_spending.

Usage

search_op_bnf(q, exact = FALSE)

Arguments

q

character vector of search terms: part of a name (case insensitive, e.g. "amoxicillin") or the start of a code ("0501", "5.1"). Results for several terms are combined.

exact

logical; if TRUE only exact code or name matches are returned.

Value

A data.frame with columns type (e.g. "BNF section", "chemical", "product", "product format"), id (the code or section number), name and, where the API supplies them, section and is_generic. Zero rows if nothing matches.

Examples

# \donttest{
search_op_bnf("amoxicillin")
#> Error: OpenPrescribing refused the request (HTTP 403, a bot-protection challenge), so no data could be retrieved from /bnf_code/.
#> This is applied by the service to some networks and clients (for example some cloud or institutional IP ranges). Try again later or from another network, and consider reducing the request rate with options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = 0.5).
search_op_bnf("5.1.1")
#> Error: OpenPrescribing refused the request (HTTP 403, a bot-protection challenge), so no data could be retrieved from /bnf_code/.
#> This is applied by the service to some networks and clients (for example some cloud or institutional IP ranges). Try again later or from another network, and consider reducing the request rate with options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = 0.5).
# }
